comments_data.body: Hello @lebaphi  - could you explain what the issue was please?

Aah, @lebaphi - I think I understand it.

Rendering Serge was taking several seconds.  We were asking for two re-renders, now we're not.

The fact that Serge rendering is (almost) instanstaneous fixes the issue, but it's right to remove the renders.

issues.title: Delay in choosing new message format
issues.body:
Some players can send multiple types of message into a channel (will provide link with demo: https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kq9ozhe6&access=pkq9oxs4h).

The choices of message type are in a combo-box at the top of the `New Message` dialog.  When switching between message types there can be a delay of up to 4 seconds for the new message template to open.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/449cd44e87ecb421fef69585ecafa60e.gif)

I don't recall this happening in past wargames (around a year ago). Here is a recording of a build from December 19:
![screencast 2](https://i.gyazo.com/c1dae638fbd67dbe1f6a8108ca0ba701.gif)

We should investigate the cause of the delay.

I've just checked the `network` tab in `developer tools`, and the delay isn't because of a server round-trip.
